scope: Private website feedback and an owner-reviewed improvement backlog
releaseStatus: Release candidate: hosted database activated; website deployment and final live verification pending at commit time
ownerStatus: User explicitly confirmed varunchinna5966@gmail.com as the sole owner. Exactly one verified auth account was resolved and configured by privileged SQL; no client-side email authorization.

routes.entry: Header Feedback button; owner inbox link appears in the account menu only after a server-side owner check

privacy.audience: Feedback entry is available to everyone; submission requires sign-in; reading/reviewing is restricted to one owner UUID, not moderators
notCollectedAutomatically: IP address in the feedback table
privacy.infrastructure: Privileged infrastructure administrators/providers remain able to access stored records; this is not end-to-end encryption
privacy.retention: No automatic deletion schedule activated; manual privacy requests through existing contact channel; finalize retention before public launch

implementation.database: Private schema, RLS enabled, direct table and sequence privileges revoked, fixed-search-path definer functions behind invoker RPC wrappers
implementation.authorization: Singleton owner UUID maintained only by a privileged operator; no client enrollment, role metadata or email-based authorization
implementation.limits: 5 new submissions per account per fixed UTC hour; 10–3000-character messages; category/section allowlists; no uploads
implementation.retries: Per-account advisory lock and request-ID uniqueness avoid duplicate inserts when retrying the same form submission
implementation.pagination: 20 visible inbox records plus one lookahead using created_at/id keyset pagination
implementation.approvals: Version-checked decisions, version-specific plan approval and private audit events; editing/reopening clears previous approval
implementation.deployment: No feedback action invokes a model, writes code, opens a PR, or deploys a website change

activationSteps: Obtain explicit confirmation of the intended sole owner account, then resolve its verified auth.users UUID using a privileged read. Do not infer from public profiles or client metadata.
Check live migration state and apply only private_owner_feedback. Do not apply unrelated pending local migrations or use a blanket database push.
Insert the confirmed UUID into private.feedback_owner using privileged SQL; never create a public enrollment endpoint. Reject attempts to add a second owner.
Verify grants, RLS and security advisors. Use isolated fixtures for mutation tests, never impersonate actual users to create test feedback in the live database.

Publish from the isolated release checkout with the already-live News, archive-source and conversation-count improvements retained. Do not overwrite the original working tree. Keep existing public-launch gates unchanged.
Verify actual signed-in owner and non-owner flows on the deployed website. Owner access is tested locally but not yet verified against the user's real login.

futureAutomation.status: Design foundation only; no scheduled job, AI processing, external sharing or paid service enabled
proposedPipeline: Batch new feedback at a low-frequency schedule; deduplicate before inference and impose daily input/token/spend caps
Remove identifiers and sensitive details; treat all feedback as untrusted data, not instructions for the model or build system
Generate structured options with evidence links, impact, alternatives, effort, risk, verification and rollback; save a new unapproved plan revision
Require the owner to approve the exact plan version in this inbox
Use a separate least-privilege implementation identity to create a draft PR in an isolated branch; no database-admin or deployment keys in the AI context
Run tests/security checks and require a separate code/release review before merge or deployment; reject stale approvals after any plan/code change
futureAutomation.stack: Reuse the current app and private Postgres backlog now; a Cloudflare scheduled Worker/Queue can be added later without introducing a second feedback database

Non-owner inbox/history calls denied, including forged owner/email user metadata

hostedSecurityAdvisors.intentionalInfo: Three private feedback tables have RLS enabled with no policies and no direct client privileges. They are deny-all tables accessed only through explicitly guarded functions.
hostedSecurityAdvisors.limits: These checks do not prove the whole website is free of security issues or replace independent security review. Existing launch gates remain closed.
